subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Architects throughout history have designed buildings to reflect the cultural values of their time periods.
• Italian architect Andrea Palladio designed the Villa Rotonda in the 1560s.
• It embodied Renaissance ideals of mathematical harmony and classical proportions inspired by ancient Roman architecture.
• American architect Frank Lloyd Wright designed Fallingwater in the 1930s.
• It reflected modern values of integration with nature and rejection of traditional geometric forms.
prompt: The student wants to contrast the Villa Rotonda with Fallingwater. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The Villa Rotonda and Fallingwater both reflect the cultural values of their respective time periods.
choices.B: Frank Lloyd Wright's Fallingwater, designed in the 1930s, reflected modern values of integration with nature and rejection of traditional forms.
choices.C: While both are significant architectural works, the Villa Rotonda embodies Renaissance mathematical harmony, whereas Fallingwater reflects modern integration with nature.
choices.D: Designed by Andrea Palladio in the 1560s, the Villa Rotonda embodied Renaissance ideals of mathematical harmony and classical proportions.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The sentence contrasts the two buildings, noting that the Villa Rotonda embodies Renaissance mathematical harmony, whereas Fallingwater reflects modern integration with nature.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. While the sentence provides a description of the Villa Rotonda, it doesn't mention Fallingwater or contrast the two buildings.
